setting: A student is talking to a staff member at the campus recreation center about a class schedule conflict.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a staff member at the recreation center.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi, I signed up for the rock climbing class that meets Tuesday evenings, but I just found out I have a lab at the same time this semester.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That's a common scheduling headache. Let me check what else is available. There's actually a Thursday section of the same class, same instructor, same skill level.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That would work perfectly. Is there space in it?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: There are two spots left, so you're in luck. I can switch you over right now if you'd like.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Also, will I lose the gear deposit I already paid for the Tuesday section?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No, deposits transfer automatically between sections of the same class, so that won't be an issue.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Great. One more thing, do I need to bring my own climbing shoes, or does the center provide them?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: We provide shoes and harnesses for the first two sessions so you can decide if you like it before buying your own gear.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: Why does the woman go to the recreation center desk?

options.text: To cancel her climbing class entirely
To resolve a scheduling conflict with her climbing class
To request a refund for her deposit
To buy her own climbing shoes

questions.explanation: She explains her lab now conflicts with her Tuesday climbing class and needs another option.
questions.correctAnswer: To resolve a scheduling conflict with her climbing class

questions.narrator_text: What solution does the staff member offer?

options.text: Enrolling her in a different sport
Switching to a Thursday section of the same class

questions.explanation: He finds a Thursday section with the same instructor and skill level with two open spots.
questions.correctAnswer: Switching to a Thursday section of the same class

questions.narrator_text: What happens to the woman's gear deposit?

options.text: It automatically transfers to the new section
It is only refundable at the end of the semester
It is forfeited when switching sections

questions.explanation: The staff member confirms deposits transfer automatically between sections of the same class.
questions.correctAnswer: It automatically transfers to the new section

questions.narrator_text: According to the staff member, what does the center provide for the first two sessions?
questions.explanation: He states the center provides shoes and harnesses for the first two sessions.
